name: feature-errors
description: App-level exception handlers: consistent JSON error body, validation errors, generic 500 handling.

variables.name: app_name
variables.description: Package name that mounts the handlers, e.g. 'app'

notes: After applying: call register_exception_handlers(app) once at startup. All errors now return {'error': {'code', 'message'}} uniformly — your frontend and agents can rely on one shape.
